explanation: The theorem says that if a ring hom η vanishes on the ideal span{ϖ^N}, it vanishes on span{ϖ^(N+j)}. The proof is a one-line combination of Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton and pow_dvd_pow. Those lemmas give the ingredients, namely the ideal inclusion span{ϖ^(N+j)} ≤ span{ϖ^N}. I found no Mathlib lemma that states this "vanishing on a smaller ideal" form for a hom, and the current proof is already the shortest derivation. I did not run a wider search of the Mathlib sources.
